title: National CAE-R Cybersecurity Ph.D. 3-Minute Thesis (3MT) Competition at IEEE CARS 2026
description:
I am honored to have participated in the National CAE-R Cybersecurity Ph.D. 3-Minute Thesis (3MT) Competition at IEEE CARS 2026, where I presented my research on AI-Driven Digital Twins for Autonomous Decision-Making.
I am grateful to receive recognition for outstanding doctoral research, innovation, and research communication.
Special thanks to my advisor, Dr. Yaqoob Majeed, for his continuous guidance and support.
